hooks.command: command -v musterd >/dev/null 2>&1 && musterd inbox --waiting >/dev/null 2>&1 || true # musterd-grok-notify

command -v musterd >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && musterd inbox --interrupt-check 2>/dev/null | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{const t=s.trim();if(t)console.log(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:t}}))})' || true # musterd-grok-interrupt
command -v musterd >/dev/null 2>&1 && musterd gate check --stdin >/dev/null 2>&1 || true # musterd-grok-gate

command -v musterd >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const {execFileSync}=require("child_process");let ev={};try{ev=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,"utf8"))}catch{}if(ev.reason!=="end_turn"||ev.stopHookActive)process.exit(0);let line="";try{line=execFileSync("musterd",["inbox","--interrupt-check"],{encoding:"utf8",stdio:["ignore","pipe","ignore"]}).trim()}catch{}if(line)console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:"block",reason:line}))' || true # musterd-grok-stop
command -v musterd >/dev/null 2>&1 && musterd session start --stdin 2>/dev/null || true # musterd-grok-capture
command -v musterd >/dev/null 2>&1 && musterd session end --stdin >/dev/null 2>&1 || true # musterd-grok-end
